title: Vendors imported with a blank term start on COD, not the default
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure Net 30 is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Make sure the shop's own term A is named "Net 10".
  • Have a vendor import file with two new vendors: vendor A with an empty credit term cell and vendor B with the credit term "NET10".
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Import the file through Settings, Data Import, Vendors.
  2. Open vendor A's vendor page.
  3. Open vendor B's vendor page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The import finishes.
  • No row is refused because of its credit term.

Step 2:

  • The "Credit term" reads COD (not Net 30).

Step 3:

  • The "Credit term" reads "Net 10" (the term's spelling).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11675 (Story 6, Vendors), story SV-11679 (Story 10, Imports and Public API)

  • S6-E1: “A vendor imported with a blank term starts on COD, as today; a vendor imported with a known term in any capitalization is saved in that term's correct spelling.”
  • S10-R3: “A credit term that matches one of the shop's terms (standard or its own) ignoring capitals and spaces is saved in that term's spelling: "net 10", "NET10" and "Net 10" all save as the shop's "Net 10".
